label: Clear glass
description: Draws glass as clear air, without a resource pack.
settings_description: Settings for the Clear glass gameplay mod. Glass in 1.8.9 is a cut-out texture whose frame and streaks cover a quarter of what is behind it; this skips glass when chunks are built, so the block is still there, still solid and still targetable — the block outline still finds it — but nothing is drawn. It is what a clear-glass resource pack does, without the pack. Changing a setting rebuilds the loaded chunks once.

clear_panes.description: Whether glass panes are cleared as well as full glass blocks.

clear_stained.description: Whether stained glass is cleared too. Off by default: stained glass carries team colour in Bedwars and bases, and clearing it would throw that away.
